items.title: Archer-Daniels-Midland (ADM) Is Planting Deeper Roots In East Africa With Nairobi Hub
items.summary: Archer-Daniels-Midland (NYSE:ADM) has opened a new marketing office in Nairobi to support its East African expansion plans. The Nairobi hub is intended to strengthen ADM's local supply chain presence and connect regional buyers with its global network. The new Kenyan office targets customers across the broader East African market, including food processors and industrial users of agricultural products. items.title: Archer Daniels Q3 Earnings Beat on Biofuel Strength, Revenues Miss
items.summary: ADM's Q3 2026 earnings surge 92.4% on strong biofuel margins and crushing gains, offsetting a revenue miss and prompting a higher full-year earnings outlook.

items.title: ADM Raises 2026 Earnings Outlook as Q3 Profit Beats Forecasts Despite Revenue Miss
items.summary: Archer Daniels Midland (NYSE:ADM) reported stronger-than-expected third-quarter 2026 earnings on Tuesday, supported by improved biofuel margins and higher operating profits across its three business segments. The agricultural commodities and processing company also raised its full-year earnings guidance, although quarterly revenue fell short of Wall Street expectations.
